market.question: Will the highest temperature in Toronto be 11°C on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: Environment Canada forecast for Toronto Pearson Apr 30 is 10°C high with 30% chance of showers. The 11°C bucket is one degree above forecast and within typical forecast error band, so probability is moderate.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cloud cover and timing of any showers could swing the high a degree either way.
